Examples

The examples/ directories in the SDK bundle contain independent examples for each language. They reference the NuGet, Wheel, or prebuilt C++ package included in the same bundle; SDK source code is not required.

Examples that connect to a camera accept an optional camera address as the first argument, such as 127.0.0.1:5000. If omitted, the example searches for cameras and uses the first device.

C#

cd <SDK_DIR>/csharp/examples/EpicEyeCapture
dotnet run
dotnet run -- 127.0.0.1:5000

The example projects restore EpicEye.SDK from the local NuGet package in <SDK_DIR>/csharp.

Python

python -m pip install <SDK_DIR>/python/epiceye-<version>-py3-none-any.whl
python <SDK_DIR>/python/examples/capture.py
python <SDK_DIR>/python/examples/capture.py 127.0.0.1:5000

C++

The supplied CMake project selects the Windows x64, Linux x86_64, or Linux ARM64 package automatically:

cd <SDK_DIR>/cpp/examples
cmake -S . -B build
cmake --build build --config Release

Linux:

./build/SearchCamera/SearchCamera
./build/EpicEyeCapture/EpicEyeCapture 127.0.0.1:5000

Windows:

.\build\SearchCamera\Release\SearchCamera.exe
.\build\EpicEyeCapture\Release\EpicEyeCapture.exe 127.0.0.1:5000

Add -DEPICEYE_BUILD_EXAMPLES_OPENCV=ON to the CMake configure command to build the OpenCV example.

Example list

Example Purpose

SearchCamera / search_camera.py

Search for cameras and print device information.

DiscoveryService / discovery_service.py

Continuously discover cameras and receive device-list changes.

CameraInfo / camera_info.py

Read camera information and reconstructor type.

TemperatureInfo / temperature_info.py

Read internal camera temperatures.

CameraConfig / camera_config.py

Read and write camera configuration and parameter presets.

CameraParameters / camera_parameters.py

Read camera parameters, camera matrix, and distortion.

CameraIPConfig / camera_ip_config.py

Configure DHCP or a static IP address.

EpicEyeCapture / capture.py

Capture and parse EpicRaw, then save images, depth maps, and point clouds.

EpicEyeCaptureOpencv / capture_opencv.py

Display and save capture results with OpenCV.

GetFrame / get_frame.py

Download EpicRaw and read selected data.

EpicRawOffline / epicraw_offline.py

Parse an existing EpicRaw file.

Stream2D / stream2d_receive.py

Open a Stream2D session and receive H264 data.

LineScan / line_scan.py

Start a line scan, wait for completion, and read status.

TextureToPointCloud / texture_to_point_cloud.py

Map texture pixels to 3D point-cloud coordinates.

IntrinsicCalibration / intrinsic_calibration.py

Collect, calculate, and optionally write intrinsic calibration results.

IntrinsicAccuracyCheck / intrinsic_accuracy_check.py

Run an intrinsic-accuracy check.

HandEyeCalibration / hand_eye_calibration.py

Select a robot, collect calibration points, calculate hand-eye calibration, and check accuracy.

UndistortLut / undistort_lut.py

Retrieve or calculate an undistortion LUT.

DepthNetworkStats

Measure EpicRaw download time and rate and decode the depth map.

passive_binocular.py

Capture passive-binocular source images and optional texture.
